tickerText: [TENNIS] WTA's one-time SRY gene screening takes effect today as Tsitsipas lifts the Gstaad title and rain-delayed finals set Badosa vs Sherif in Iași and Sakkari vs Krejcikova in Athens • [SQUASH] World Squash Junior Championships open in Niagara-on-the-Lake as top seed Anahat Singh leads India's individual campaign through July 25 • [BADMINTON] Sindhu and Popov sweep Japan Open singles crowns in Tokyo as the $2 million VICTOR China Open Super 1000 opens Tuesday in Changzhou • [PICKLEBALL] Collin Johns and Len Yang headline the inaugural PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open from July 23–26 with a $79,000 purse at Sports Arina • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Feeder Ulaanbaatar qualifying rolls on in Mongolia while Kanak Jha and Lily Zhang head to Brazil for Star Contender São José dos Campos starting July 21

newsItems.title: WTA Rolls Out One-Time Gene Screening
newsItems.excerpt: The WTA's updated eligibility policy takes effect today, requiring a one-time SRY gene test via cheek swab or blood sample for all players competing on the women's tour.

newsItems.title: China Open Super 1000 Opens in Changzhou
newsItems.excerpt: The VICTOR China Open begins Tuesday with a $2 million prize pool at Changzhou's Olympic Sports Center, the first BWF Super 1000 stop after Sindhu's Japan Open triumph.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open Set for Debut
newsItems.excerpt: Collin Johns, Len Yang and Long Yufei headline the inaugural PPA Asia 500 at Sports Arina from July 23–26, Singapore's highest-tier pro pickleball event with $79,000 on offer.

newsItems.title: WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Kanak Jha, the Naresh brothers and Lily Zhang join Hugo Calderano's home field as Brazil hosts a WTT Star Contender from July 21–26 with 600 ranking points to the champion.
